name: SavvyCal
desc: Scheduling tool that lets invitees overlay their calendar when picking a time.

actions.name: create_event
actions.description: Books a meeting on a scheduling link at a specific time slot.

actions.name: cancel_event
actions.description: Cancels a scheduled meeting in SavvyCal.

actions.name: get_event
actions.description: Retrieves the details of a specific scheduled meeting by its ID.

actions.name: list_events
actions.description: Returns a list of scheduled meetings from your SavvyCal account.

actions.name: find_events_by_email
actions.description: Returns all events where the attendee's email matches the given address.

actions.name: list_scheduling_links
actions.description: Returns all scheduling links configured in your SavvyCal account.

actions.name: get_scheduling_link
actions.description: Retrieves the details of a specific scheduling link by its ID.

actions.name: get_link_slots
actions.description: Returns available time slots for booking on a scheduling link. Useful for displaying availability or for picking a slot before calling Create Event.

actions.name: toggle_scheduling_link
actions.description: Switches a scheduling link between active and disabled states.

actions.name: duplicate_scheduling_link
actions.description: Creates a copy of an existing scheduling link.

actions.name: delete_scheduling_link
actions.description: Permanently deletes a scheduling link from your SavvyCal account.

actions.name: list_workflows
actions.description: Returns all workflows configured in your SavvyCal account.

actions.name: get_workflow_rules
actions.description: Returns the rules configured for a specific workflow.

actions.name: get_current_user
actions.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated SavvyCal user.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a SavvyCal event occurs. Select one or more event types, or leave empty to trigger on all types.

triggers.name: new_poll_response
triggers.description: Triggers when a poll response is created or updated in SavvyCal.

triggers.name: workflow_action_triggered
triggers.description: Triggers when a workflow action is triggered in SavvyCal.
